parameters.description: Voltage of the weather station console's battery as Home Assistant reports it.
1 when the voltage reading is available, else 0. Absent means 1. The voltage is then 0.0.
Epoch seconds of the last report of the voltage, from the Home Assistant helper of this name. Absent until the stateful model uses it.
1 when the reported time is available, else 0. Absent means 1. Absent until the stateful model uses it.
Epoch seconds when the model is called. Absent until the stateful model uses it.
Estimated battery capacity left, in steps of 5, 0 to 100, one level across the 3.77 to 3.83 V plateau.
1 when the capacity is a prediction, 0 when the voltage was flagged not valid and the capacity is 0.
